//: TESTS ARE EXCLUDED FROM THIS TYPECHECK, deliberately.
This config sets types to @cloudflare/workers-types, which is what the code
actually runs on. A vitest file needs vitest's types, and the two cannot
share a program: workers-types and Node's lib both declare ReadableStream,
console and crypto, and vitest/globals pulls tinybench, whose EventTarget
is incompatible with the Workers one. Every arrangement tried produced a
dozen errors about the toolchain and none about the code.
So the tests are typechecked by vitest's own transpile at run time rather
than by tsc. The production code -- the part that ships -- keeps its strict
Workers typing, which is the half that matters.
